column1: # Shared conformance corpus: what you type -> what the client receives.
# Read by test/e2e/drive.py (fcitx5 addon and .mim) and by
# test/keylayout/simulate.py (macOS). One tab between the columns.
# Rows whose input a target cannot produce are skipped by that target and
# counted, rather than quietly passing. The macOS layout can only type the
# ASCII apostrophe and backtick, so the exotic tutuq belgisi rows below are
# skipped there and exercised only on Linux.
